note:
⛔ SNG-518. THE SUNK ASSAY, LEVEL 1 — THE INTAKE. Authored opponent sheets, buildable today.
⚠️ CCODE'S FINDING CHANGED THIS LEVEL BEFORE IT EXISTED: the obscure bonus is INERT because the default declaration pool is `strike`/`shield` and ZERO authored opponents use a sense function. ⛔ SO A LEVEL WHERE ONLY THE OPPONENTS OBSCURE GIVES THE PARTY NOTHING TO EARN FROM — the party can only read, and readers bank nothing.
⛔ THE FIX IS THE CONTENT, NOT THE DIAL. Three of these five READ. The party's obscure pays here because somebody is looking.
_theDial: ⚠️ CCode: 'obscure's strength is exactly how often opponents look. Widening the null band does nothing; giving three opponents a `reveal` craft does everything.' ⛔ THIS FILE IS THAT DIAL SET FOR THE FIRST TIME.

opponents.name: A Grave-Caller, watching the stair

soakLayers.source: oiled leathers and a heavy apron
⛔ a Greyhearth reckoner's habit — the damp does not touch them

opponents._designNote: ⛔ THE PARTY'S OBSCURE PAYS AGAINST THIS ONE. It declares `reveal` roughly a third of rounds, and a player who obscures and beats it earns the bonus action. ⚠️ IT IS ALSO THE ONE THE PARTY MOST WANTS TO SLIP — it is the one that will name them.
opponents._targetPolicy: ⛔ `healer` — ⛔ IT READS THE PARTY AND ITS OWN NOTE SAYS 'IT IS THE ONE THAT WILL NAME THEM.' A thing whose whole role is reading picks the mark that reading reveals — whoever is holding the others up. ⚠️ AND IT IS THE ANSWER TO ITS OWN DESIGN NOTE: a party that obscures does not merely dodge a read, it stops its healer being CHOSEN. ⚠️ AUTHORED 2026-08-24 (Aevi) per CCODE-247. THE DEFAULT IS `threat` AND A DEVIATION MUST MEAN SOMETHING: a foe that goes for the healer or the weakest is SAYING SOMETHING ABOUT ITSELF. Two of these five stay `threat` deliberately.

opponents.name: A Grave-Caller in the barrel-shadow
opponents._designNote: ⛔ DECLARES OBSCURE AS A MATTER OF COURSE, which is what the level was written for. ⚠️ AGAINST A READING PARTY IT WINS TIES AND COSTS THEM THEIR SENSE TIER — and the party feels the tie rule here, which is the intended lesson.
opponents._targetPolicy: ⛔ `threat` — ⚠️ IT DECLARES OBSCURE AS A MATTER OF COURSE — it is spending its attention on not being seen, not on studying who to hit. ⛔ SO IT HITS WHOEVER IS HURTING IT, which is the honest read of something concentrating elsewhere. ⚠️ AUTHORED 2026-08-24 (Aevi) per CCODE-247. THE DEFAULT IS `threat` AND A DEVIATION MUST MEAN SOMETHING: a foe that goes for the healer or the weakest is SAYING SOMETHING ABOUT ITSELF. Two of these five stay `threat` deliberately.

opponents.name: The set-crew foreman

soakLayers.source: a mail shirt under the apron
⚠️ they already have what they want — there is nothing here to offer them

opponents._designNote: ⛔ THE BARGAIN DOOR. It will trade passage for the ledgers, and it declares `bargain` when the party has something. ⚠️ ITS APPETITE LAYER IS THE POINT: an Abyssal craft finds nothing to reach for, so the bargain must be a real exchange rather than a lever.
opponents._targetPolicy: ⛔ `threat` — ⛔ IT WANTS THE LEDGERS, NOT THE PARTY. A foreman who bargains for passage is not trying to kill anyone — it strikes what is actually stopping it, and it stops striking the moment the trade is on the table. ⚠️ BAIT-ABLE ON PURPOSE. ⚠️ AUTHORED 2026-08-24 (Aevi) per CCODE-247. THE DEFAULT IS `threat` AND A DEVIATION MUST MEAN SOMETHING: a foe that goes for the healer or the weakest is SAYING SOMETHING ABOUT ITSELF. Two of these five stay `threat` deliberately.

opponents.name: Set labour, hauling

soakLayers.source: ⛔ it does not flinch and does not tire

opponents._designNote:
⛔ NO MIND. Soul Stare r1 and r2 do nothing to it; r3 does — 'everything has an essence' is the rank that reaches a set body. ⚠️ Keening does nothing to it either: anything that cannot feel is unaffected, and this is where a party learns that bound is real.
⛔ IT ALSO CANNOT BE CUT-THREADED. A set body has no thread — the same law that protects the Warden.
opponents._targetPolicy: ⛔ `blind` — ⛔ NO MIND. Its own note: 'Soul Stare r1 and r2 do nothing to it… anything that cannot feel is unaffected.' ⚠️ A SET BODY DOES NOT CHOOSE A TARGET — it works on whatever is in front of it, and `blind` is the only honest policy for a thing with no intent. Protecting someone from it is a matter of standing somewhere, not of drawing its attention. ⚠️ AUTHORED 2026-08-24 (Aevi) per CCODE-247. THE DEFAULT IS `threat` AND A DEVIATION MUST MEAN SOMETHING: a foe that goes for the healer or the weakest is SAYING SOMETHING ABOUT ITSELF. Two of these five stay `threat` deliberately.

opponents.name: A mourner who came down with them

soakLayers.source: ⛔ a threnodist is not moved by what moves other people

opponents._designNote: ⚠️ THE THIRD READER, AND THE ONE THAT MAKES THE LEVEL'S SENSE STEP LIVE. ⛔ ITS FEELING LAYER IS A WALL: Force the Move, Quiet the Room and Grief Strike all land badly here, and a party leaning on emotional crafts will need another answer.
opponents._targetPolicy: ⛔ `weakest` — ⚠️ IT READS EMOTION. ⛔ SO IT FINDS THE ONE WHO IS ALREADY FRIGHTENED — not the most dangerous and not the most useful, THE ONE MOST AFFECTED. That is characterisation, not difficulty: a thing that hunts by feeling goes where the feeling is loudest, and the party's most rattled member is the loudest thing in the room. ⚠️ AUTHORED 2026-08-24 (Aevi) per CCODE-247. THE DEFAULT IS `threat` AND A DEVIATION MUST MEAN SOMETHING: a foe that goes for the healer or the weakest is SAYING SOMETHING ABOUT ITSELF. Two of these five stay `threat` deliberately.

_threeSolutions.fight: ⛔ Five opponents, three of whom read. A party that never obscures gives up the sense step entirely.
_threeSolutions.bargain: ⚠️ The foreman trades passage for the ledgers. `Known Price` or `Worth the Work` closes it in one exchange; without either it costs the ledgers AND coin.
_threeSolutions.slip: ⛔ A route exists past the barrel-shadow. It needs `obscure` or concealment against three readers — which is exactly when the obscure bonus pays.
_threeSolutions._rule: ⛔ THE LEVEL MUST NOT REWARD ONE. Each path costs something the others keep: the fight costs energy and the ledgers stay clean; the bargain costs the ledgers; slipping costs the coin on the floor.

_treasure.the_assay_ledgers: ⚠️ Worth more to Greyhearth than to Amaranth. The party chose an employer by taking them.
_treasure.loose_coin: Enough to pay the foreman rather than fight — ⛔ ON THE FLOOR IN THE ROOM WITH THE READERS.
